Contributors: Thailand. Krom Phǣnthī Thahān, cartographer, issuing body

Maps of Lop Burī Province published by Thai Royal Survey Department in the central region of Thailand. Lop Burī is on the east side of the Chao Phraya River valley. It is between the Lopburi River and Pa Sak Rivers, most of the land is mixed plains and hills. Maps show boundaries by jurisdiction names of districts and subdivided into subdistricts and villages. Also includes cadatral maps of specific land parcels, with lots, and lot numbers.
